policy: Every field starts protected. Writing requires all of: no protect rule matches the field name or its measured label; the PDF type is text or dropdown; the name matches an allowlisted fact descriptor; the resolved value matches the descriptor's declared type; a sensitive descriptor has been named for that exact field; and an indexed charge row resolves to a charge actually supplied.

bindingCorrectionRationale.p1.r432.4.x173.rule: 'Court Address' resolves to participant.street_address on a bare address match. It is the court's address.
bindingCorrectionRationale.p2.r682.9.x355.rule: 'a nonprofit provider: (name of provider)' resolves to participant.full_legal_name on a bare name match. It names an organisation representing the petitioner, not the petitioner.
bindingCorrectionRationale.p5.r511.4.x284.rule: 'State income tax' resolves to participant.state on a bare \bstate\b match, and the blank is a dollar amount on a withholding line. Writing a two-letter state code into a money field would be a plain misstatement of the declarant's finances.
bindingCorrectionRationale.p7.r675.7.x221.rule: 'Business name' on the employment page resolves to participant.full_legal_name. It names an employer.
bindingCorrectionRationale.p7.r552.5.x221.rule: second employer entry, same resolution and same refusal.
bindingCorrectionRationale.p7.r651.7.x221.rule: 'Address & phone' beneath an employer's name resolves to participant.street_address. It is the employer's address.
bindingCorrectionRationale.p7.r528.5.x221.rule: second employer entry, same resolution and same refusal.
bindingCorrectionRationale.p9.r666.6.x217.rule: 'Name(s) on title' for real property resolves to participant.full_legal_name and may name co-owners this lane knows nothing about.
bindingCorrectionRationale.p9.r504.6.x217.rule: second property entry, same resolution and same refusal.
bindingCorrectionRationale.p9.r626.1.x108.rule: 'First mortgage or lien holder (name & address)' resolves to participant.street_address. It names a creditor.
bindingCorrectionRationale.p9.r464.1.x108.rule: second property entry, same resolution and same refusal.
bindingCorrectionRationale.p9.r594.8.x108.rule: 'Second mortgage or lien holder (name & address)', same resolution and same refusal.
bindingCorrectionRationale.p9.r432.8.x108.rule: second property entry, same resolution and same refusal.

weakeningsApplied: none — no D0 protect rule, type guard or readable-size floor was relaxed for this family
